item.title: On A.I. regulation and messaging
item.description:
📝 Many people outside this bubble think of regulation as something that constrains corporate power and benefits ordinary people. We try very hard to make proposals that disadvantage (slow down) frontier AI companies while *advantaging* smaller competitors. Overall my view is that AI is *structurally* a technology that tends to concentrate power, for reasons that have nothing to do with regulation (more to do with the extreme implications of the scaling laws).
🔗 Read more: https://twitter.com/DarioAmodei/status/2088758816376807762
